_note: Story 056 + owner decision (two currencies). Pretend money only, never bought with real money, never pay-to-win, English help never sold. TIPS ($) are earned only by working (client tips) and buy salon upgrades and tools. COINS are earned from the daily gift, streak milestones, the daily goal ring and level-ups, and will buy cosmetics (outfits, decorations). streak: a day counts when at least one appointment is finished that local day (not a walk-out). freeze: one free streak freeze a week, earned by playing that week, covers exactly one missed day, at most maxHeld kept. gift: the daily free gift in coins (min-max, sometimes a bonus). milestones: more coins the first time the streak reaches each day count (again after it starts over). coins.welcome: a one-time welcome gift (also for saves from before coins). coins.goal: reaching the daily goal ring. coins.levelUp: each level (rank) up.
